sensesIntro.en: Space means an empty area, the region beyond the earth, or a gap.

definition_en: a vehicle designed to travel in space, crewed or unmanned
core_image: 银白色的航天器在地球弧线之上缓缓展开太阳能板
scene: 这艘航天器成功进入了轨道。The spacecraft entered orbit successfully.

senses.title: A space vehicle
senses.definition: any vehicle built to travel in space

senses.example: The spacecraft entered orbit successfully.

senses.title: An unmanned probe

senses.example: The spacecraft sent back pictures of Mars.

branches.en: To span time is to hold both ends at once.
branches.cn: 跨越时间，就是同时握住两端。

intro.en: Span forms a verb paradigm and several compound nouns.
intro.cn: span 构成动词变化形式和若干复合名词。

latinIntro.en: Span has no Latin root; it comes from Old English spann.
latinIntro.cn: span 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语 spann。

items.example: The bridge has a wide span.

items.exampleCN: 她的职业生涯跨越了四十年。

items.example: A bridge spanning the river was built.
items.exampleCN: 一座横跨河流的桥建成了。

items.meaning: the width of a bird's wings
items.example: The eagle has a huge wingspan.
The lifespan of the insect is short.
He tightened the bolt with a spanner.
A long stretch of road lay ahead.

definition_en: to give time or money, to save, to forgive, or kept as extra
core_image: 柜子里放着一把备用钥匙，静静等着需要它的那天
scene: 你能抽出几分钟吗？Can you spare a few minutes?
sceneCN: 这里 spare 是「抽出」（第 1 个义项）；句意：你能抽出几分钟吗？

senses.title: To give time or resources
senses.definition: to be able to give time, money, or effort to someone
senses.definitionCN: 能够把时间、金钱或精力分给别人
senses.example: Can you spare a few minutes?
senses.why: This is the everyday sense of making room for others.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常表示为他人腾出余地的含义。

senses.title: To forgive
senses.definition: to choose not to harm or punish someone
senses.definitionCN: 选择不伤害或惩罚某人
senses.example: The king spared the prisoner.
senses.why: To spare is to hold back the blow.
senses.whyCN: 饶恕，就是把打击收住。

senses.title: Kept as extra
senses.definition: kept in addition in case it is needed
senses.definitionCN: 额外保留以备需要
senses.example: We keep a spare key under the mat.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在垫子下放了一把备用钥匙。
senses.why: What is set aside is being spared for later.
senses.whyCN: 被留出来的东西，就是为以后省下的。

intro.en: Spare first meant to hold back from harming.
intro.cn: spare 最初意为克制不去伤害。

items.en: Sparian meant to refrain from harming or using.
items.cn: sparian 意为不伤害或不使用。

items.en: The form became spare and kept mercy.
items.cn: 词形变为 spare，保留宽恕之义。

items.en: It came to mean to save or set aside.
items.cn: 它开始表示节省或留出。

items.en: The adjective named what is kept extra.
items.cn: 形容词指额外保留的东西。

items.en: Phrases like spare time fixed the modern uses.
items.cn: spare time 等短语固定了现代用法。

note.en: Spare is compared with look-alike words and words for saving.
note.cn: 把 spare 与形近词以及表示节省、宽恕的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: To spare is to loosen your hold on something for someone else.
normalIntro.cn: spare 是为别人放松对某物的握持。

normal.en: Can you spare a few minutes?
normal.cn: 你能抽出几分钟吗？

normal.en: The king spared the prisoner.
normal.cn: 国王饶了那个囚犯。

normal.en: We keep a spare key under the mat.
normal.cn: 我们在垫子下放了一把备用钥匙。

normal.en: He spares no effort in his work.
normal.cn: 他在工作中不遗余力。

normal.en: Spare a thought for those who are cold.
normal.cn: 体谅一下那些受冻的人。

abstract.en: Spare is a word that makes room for mercy.
abstract.cn: spare 是一个为宽恕腾出空间的词。

abstract.en: What we spare, we still care for.
abstract.cn: 我们饶过的东西，说明我们仍在意。

abstract.en: A spare minute is a gift with no wrapping.
abstract.cn: 空出的一分钟，是一份没有包装的礼物。

examples.en: Can you spare a few minutes?
The king spared the prisoner.
We keep a spare key under the mat.
examples.cn: 我们在垫子下放了一把备用钥匙。

dict_mnemonic.text: spare 既是动词也是形容词；spare time 是「空闲时间」，spare no effort 是「不遗余力」，spare key 是「备用钥匙」，sparingly 是「节省地」。

root: 来自古英语 sparian（不伤害、不使用），核心义为克制与保留，后分化为抽出、饶恕与备用。

sensesIntro.en: Spare means to give time or resources, to forgive, or to keep something extra.
sensesIntro.cn: spare 指抽出时间或资源、饶恕他人，或保留备用的东西。

core.en: Holding back what could be used or given.
core.cn: 对本可使用或给予之物的克制。

branches.en: A busy person pauses to listen.
branches.cn: 忙碌的人停下来倾听。

branches.en: A hand is raised to strike but stops.
branches.cn: 举起来要打的手停住了。

branches.en: A spare key waits under a mat.
branches.cn: 一把备用钥匙等在垫子下。

branches.en: Giving time and giving mercy are both letting go.
branches.cn: 给出时间与给出宽恕，都是放手。

branches.en: What is spared is kept for a future need.
branches.cn: 被饶过或保留的，是留给未来需要的。

intro.en: Spare forms a verb paradigm and two derived modifiers.
intro.cn: spare 构成动词变化形式和两个派生修饰词。

latinIntro.en: Spare has no Latin root; it comes from Old English sparian.
latinIntro.cn: spare 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语 sparian。

items.example: Can you spare a few minutes?
He is sparing with his words.

items.exampleCN: 这个房间布置得很简朴。

items.example: The spareness of the design pleased her.
He was unsparing in his criticism.

definition_zh: 火花；引发；一丝（希望或兴趣）
definition_en: a small burning particle, to cause something to start, or a trace of a feeling
core_image: 营火中迸出一点橙红的火星，落在干燥的草地上
scene: 火星从营火中迸溅出来。A spark flew from the campfire.
sceneCN: 这里 spark 是「火花」（第 1 个义项）；句意：火星从营火中迸溅出来。

senses.title: A small flame
senses.definition: a tiny piece of burning material flying from a fire
senses.definitionCN: 从火中飞出的细小燃烧颗粒
senses.example: A spark flew from the campfire.
senses.exampleCN: 火星从营火中迸溅出来。
senses.why: This is the oldest and most physical sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最古老、最具体的含义。

senses.title: To set off
senses.definition: to cause something such as an argument or change to begin
senses.definitionCN: 使争论、变化等开始发生
senses.example: The remark sparked a heated debate.
senses.exampleCN: 这句话引发了一场激烈的争论。
senses.why: A spark starts a fire, so the verb came to mean starting anything.
senses.whyCN: 火星能点燃火焰，动词因此表示点燃任何事情。

senses.title: A trace of feeling
senses.definition: a small amount of a feeling such as hope or interest
senses.definitionCN: 希望、兴趣等情感的微小分量
senses.example: There was still a spark of hope in her eyes.
senses.why: A single spark can keep a fire alive, just as a trace keeps hope alive.
senses.whyCN: 一点火星能让火不灭，正如一丝念想让希望延续。

intro.en: Spark is an old English word for a flying bit of fire.
intro.cn: spark 是古英语中表示飞溅火粒的词。

items.en: Spearca meant a small burning particle.
items.cn: spearca 意为细小的燃烧颗粒。

items.en: The form became sparke, still a flying spark of fire.
items.cn: 词形变为 sparke，仍指飞溅的火星。

items.en: The verb meant to send out sparks.
items.cn: 动词形式表示迸出火星。

items.en: It grew figurative, meaning to set off an event.
items.cn: 它引申为引发某个事件。

items.en: A spark of hope borrowed the image of a surviving flame.
items.cn: a spark of hope 借用了火种不灭的意象。

note.en: Spark is compared with look-alike words and words for small flashes.
note.cn: 把 spark 与形近词以及表示细小闪光的词作比较。

entries.definition: to shine with small points of light

normalIntro.en: Spark names the smallest piece of fire and whatever starts a fire.
normalIntro.cn: spark 指最小的火粒，也指点燃一切的起因。

normal.en: A spark flew from the campfire.
normal.cn: 火星从营火中迸溅出来。

normal.en: The remark sparked a heated debate.
normal.cn: 这句话引发了一场激烈的争论。

normal.en: There was still a spark of hope in her eyes.
normal.cn: 她眼中仍有一丝希望。

normal.en: The wire gave a blue electric spark.
normal.cn: 电线迸出一朵蓝色的电火花。

normal.en: One spark was enough to light the dry grass.
normal.cn: 一点火星就足以点燃干草。

abstract.en: Every great fire begins as a spark.
abstract.cn: 每一场大火都始于一点火星。

abstract.en: A spark is a promise made by fire.
abstract.cn: 火星是火焰许下的承诺。

abstract.en: Ideas spread like sparks in dry wind.
abstract.cn: 思想像干风中的火星一样蔓延。

examples.en: A spark flew from the campfire.
examples.cn: 火星从营火中迸溅出来。

examples.en: The remark sparked a heated debate.
examples.cn: 这句话引发了一场激烈的争论。

examples.en: There was still a spark of hope in her eyes.

dict_mnemonic.text: spark 是火花，也作动词「引发」；sparkle 是「闪耀」，sparkler 是「烟花棒」，spark plug 是「火花塞」，a spark of hope 是「一丝希望」。

root: 来自古英语 spearca（火星），本义为飞溅的细小燃烧颗粒，后引申为引发事件，并喻指希望或兴趣的一丝火种。

sensesIntro.en: Spark means a small flying flame, to set something off, or a trace of feeling.
sensesIntro.cn: spark 指飞溅的小火粒、引发某事，或情感的一丝痕迹。

core.en: A tiny point of fire that starts something.

branches.en: A bright grain jumps from the flames.
branches.cn: 一粒亮光从火焰中跳出。

branches.en: One sentence sets a whole room arguing.
branches.cn: 一句话让整个房间争论起来。

branches.en: A faint light remains in tired eyes.
branches.cn: 疲惫的眼中仍留着微弱的光。

branches.en: The fire grain and the quarrel share one beginning.
branches.cn: 火星与争吵共享同一个开端。

branches.en: Starting a fire and keeping hope both need one small spark.
branches.cn: 点火与守候希望，都需要一点火星。

intro.en: Spark forms verbs, nouns, and compounds.
intro.cn: spark 构成动词、名词和复合词。

latinIntro.en: Spark is Germanic and has no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: spark 属日耳曼语，没有拉丁词根。

items.example: A spark flew from the campfire.
items.exampleCN: 火星从营火中迸溅出来。

items.example: Sparks rose into the night sky.

items.exampleCN: 迸着火星的电线让我们担心。
她的眼睛闪着喜悦的光。
她穿着一条闪闪发亮的裙子。

definition_en: to say words, to give a speech, or to use a language
core_image: 母亲俯身对孩子轻声说话，孩子仰头认真听着
scene: 她轻声对孩子们说话。She spoke softly to the children.
sceneCN: 这里 speak 是「说话」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她轻声对孩子们说话。

senses.title: To say words
senses.definition: to say words with your voice
senses.definitionCN: 用嗓音说出词语
senses.example: She spoke softly to the children.
senses.why: This is the basic everyday sense of using the voice.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常使用嗓音说话的基本含义。

senses.title: To address an audience
senses.definition: to give a formal talk to a group
senses.definitionCN: 向一群人作正式讲话
senses.example: She spoke at the conference.
senses.why: Speaking to many people became a formal act with its own sense.
senses.whyCN: 对众人讲话成为一种正式行为，因而单列一义。

senses.title: To use a language
senses.definition: to be able to use a particular language
senses.definitionCN: 能够使用某种语言
senses.example: Do you speak French?
senses.why: Knowing a language is shown by speaking it.
senses.whyCN: 掌握一门语言，正体现在能说这门语言。

intro.en: Speak comes from an old English verb meaning to say or talk.
intro.cn: speak 来自古英语中表示说或谈的动词。

items.en: Specan meant to speak or talk.
items.cn: specan 意为说话或交谈。

items.en: The verb became speken and kept its meaning.
items.cn: 动词变为 speken，含义不变。

items.en: The past forms became spoke and spoken.
items.cn: 过去式与过去分词定为 spoke 和 spoken。

items.en: To speak at an event meant to give a formal talk.
items.cn: 在活动中 speak 表示作正式发言。

items.en: To speak a language meant to command it in speech.
items.cn: speak a language 表示能够在口头使用该语言。

note.en: Speak is compared with look-alike words and other verbs of saying.
note.cn: 把 speak 与形近词以及其他表示说的动词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Speak is the act of putting words into the air.
normalIntro.cn: speak 是把词语送进空气里的动作。

normal.en: She spoke softly to the children.
normal.cn: 她轻声对孩子们说话。

normal.en: She spoke at the conference.
normal.cn: 她在会议上发了言。

normal.en: Do you speak French?
normal.cn: 你讲法语吗？

normal.en: Please speak up so everyone can hear.
normal.cn: 请大声说，让大家都能听见。

normal.en: He spoke for the whole team.
normal.cn: 他代表整个团队发言。

abstract.en: To speak is to hand a thought across the air.
abstract.cn: 说话，就是把念头递过空气。

abstract.en: Words spoken cannot be taken back.
abstract.cn: 说出口的话收不回来。

abstract.en: A language lives only while someone speaks it.
abstract.cn: 一门语言只在有人讲它时活着。

examples.en: She spoke softly to the children.
She spoke at the conference.
Do you speak French?

dict_mnemonic.text: speak 是说话，speaker 是「说话者、扬声器」，speech 是「演讲、言语」；speak up 是「大声说」，speak out 是「公开表态」，speak for 是「代表发言」。

root: 来自古英语 specan（说、谈），属日耳曼语族，与 speech 同源，核心义为用嗓音发出有意义的词语。

sensesIntro.en: Speak means to say words, to address a group, or to use a language.
sensesIntro.cn: speak 指说出词语、向众人发言，或使用某种语言。

core.en: Voice turned into meaning.

branches.en: A mother murmurs to her child.
branches.cn: 母亲对孩子低声细语。

branches.en: A figure stands before a hall of listeners.
branches.cn: 一个人站在满堂听众面前。

branches.en: Two strangers greet each other in a second tongue.
branches.cn: 两个陌生人用第二语言互相问候。

branches.en: Quiet talk and public address both use the same voice.
branches.cn: 私语与演说使用同一个嗓音。

branches.en: Mastering a language lets you speak before any audience.
branches.cn: 掌握一门语言，就能在任何听众前发言。

intro.en: Speak forms nouns for people and for the act of speaking.
intro.cn: speak 构成表示人和说话行为的名词。

latinIntro.en: Speak is Germanic and has no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: speak 属日耳曼语，没有拉丁词根。

items.example: She spoke softly to the children.
The words were spoken in anger.
items.exampleCN: 那些话是在气头上说的。

items.example: She is speaking on the phone.
The speaker was easy to hear.
items.exampleCN: 发言人的声音很容易听清。
他作了一个简短的演讲。

definition_zh: 演讲者；扬声器；说某种语言的人
definition_en: a person who gives a speech, a device that makes sound, or a person who speaks a language
core_image: 演讲者站在讲台后，台下坐满抬头聆听的观众
scene: 演讲者走上讲台。The speaker walked to the podium.
sceneCN: 这里 speaker 是「演讲者」（第 1 个义项）；句意：演讲者走上讲台。

senses.title: A person who speaks
senses.definition: a person who gives a speech or talk
senses.definitionCN: 发表演讲或讲话的人
senses.example: The speaker walked to the podium.
senses.why: This is the sense closest to the verb speak.
senses.whyCN: 这是最接近动词 speak 的含义。

senses.title: A sound device
senses.definition: a device that turns electrical signals into sound
senses.definitionCN: 把电信号变成声音的装置
senses.example: The speaker on my phone is broken.
senses.why: A machine that speaks for a recording borrowed the name.
senses.whyCN: 替录音发声的机器借用了这个名字。

senses.title: A language user
senses.definition: a person who speaks a particular language
senses.definitionCN: 使用某种特定语言的人
senses.example: She is a native speaker of Spanish.
senses.why: Native speaker names a person by the language they speak.
senses.whyCN: native speaker 以所讲的语言来指称一个人。

intro.en: Speaker is speak with the old suffix for one who does.
intro.cn: speaker 是 speak 加上表示「做某事的人」的古老后缀。

items.en: The agent suffix -ari named the doer of an action.
items.cn: 施事后缀 -ari 用来指动作的发出者。

items.en: Spekere meant a person who speaks.
items.cn: spekere 意为说话的人。

items.en: Speaker became the title of one who addresses a meeting.
items.cn: speaker 成为对会议发言者的称呼。

items.en: The device that produces sound took the same name.
items.cn: 产生声音的装置也用了这个名称。

items.en: Native speaker named a person by their first language.
items.cn: native speaker 按一个人的母语来指称他。

note.en: Speaker is compared with look-alike words and words for talkers.
note.cn: 把 speaker 与形近词以及表示发言人的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who reads news aloud

normalIntro.en: A speaker is anyone or anything that makes words heard.
normalIntro.cn: speaker 是任何让词语被听见的人或物。

normal.en: The speaker walked to the podium.
normal.cn: 演讲者走上讲台。

normal.en: The speaker on my phone is broken.
normal.cn: 我手机的扬声器坏了。

normal.en: She is a native speaker of Spanish.
normal.cn: 她是西班牙语母语者。

normal.en: The guest speaker arrived early.
normal.cn: 特邀演讲人早早到了。

normal.en: Music poured from the speaker system.
normal.cn: 音乐从音响系统里涌出。

abstract.en: Every speaker lends a voice to an idea.
abstract.cn: 每位演讲者都为想法借出一个声音。

abstract.en: A speaker is a bridge between thought and crowd.
abstract.cn: 演讲者是思想与人群之间的桥。

abstract.en: Silence is the only speech a speaker cannot give.
abstract.cn: 沉默是演讲者唯一讲不出的演说。

examples.en: The speaker walked to the podium.
The speaker on my phone is broken.
She is a native speaker of Spanish.

dict_mnemonic.text: speaker 由 speak 加 -er 构成，本指「说话的人」，引申为「演讲者」和「扬声器」；native speaker 是「母语者」，loudspeaker 是「喇叭」，speakership 是「议长职位」。

root: 由 speak（说）加施事后缀 -er 构成，本义为说话的人，后指公开演讲者，又借指替人发声的扬声器。

sensesIntro.en: Speaker means a person giving a talk, a device for sound, or a person who uses a language.
sensesIntro.cn: speaker 指发表讲话的人、发声的装置，或使用某种语言的人。

core.en: The source from which speech comes.

branches.en: A figure rises before a listening hall.
branches.cn: 一个人站起在聆听的大厅前。

branches.en: A small box fills the room with music.
branches.cn: 一个小盒子让房间充满音乐。

branches.en: A stranger answers in her mother tongue.
branches.cn: 陌生人用母语回答。

branches.en: Both the person and the device deliver sound.
branches.cn: 人和装置都在传递声音。

branches.en: A device and a language user both give voice to words.
branches.cn: 装置与语言使用者都让词语发声。

intro.en: Speaker forms compounds and related agent nouns.
intro.cn: speaker 构成复合词和相关施事名词。

latinIntro.en: The suffix -er is Germanic and marks the doer.
latinIntro.cn: 后缀 -er 属日耳曼语，表示动作的发出者。

The speakers sat in a row.

definition_zh: 特别的；专门的；特色菜（或特价品）
definition_en: different from the usual, intended for one purpose, or a dish offered on a particular day
core_image: 餐桌上点着蜡烛，摆着一份与平日不同的精致晚餐
scene: 今天是个特别的日子。Today is a special day.
sceneCN: 这里 special 是「特别的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：今天是个特别的日子。

senses.title: Out of the ordinary
senses.definition: better or different from what is usual
senses.definitionCN: 比寻常更好或与寻常不同的
senses.example: Today is a special day.
senses.why: This is the everyday sense of something set apart from the ordinary.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常表示某事物不同于寻常的含义。

intro.en: Species is Latin for appearance and kind, borrowed whole into English.
intro.cn: species 是拉丁语中表示外观和种类的词，整体借入英语。

items.en: Species meant a look, a form, or a kind.
items.cn: species 意为外观、形态或种类。

items.en: Scholars used it for a class within a genus.
items.cn: 学者用它指属之下的一个类别。

items.en: Species entered English as a logical term for kind.
items.cn: species 作为表示种类的逻辑术语进入英语。

items.en: Biology narrowed it to a breeding group.
items.cn: 生物学把它收窄为能繁殖的一群生物。

items.en: Conservation made endangered species a common phrase.
items.cn: 自然保护让 endangered species 成为常用说法。

note.en: Species is compared with look-alike words and words for kinds.

abstract.en: A species is a family written in blood and time.
abstract.cn: 物种是用血脉与时间写成的家族。

abstract.en: Each species is one answer to the question of living.
abstract.cn: 每个物种都是对生存问题的一种回答。

abstract.en: Lose a species and the world loses a word.
abstract.cn: 失去一个物种，世界就失去一个词。

definition_en: clearly described, exact, or relating to one particular thing
core_image: 一张清单上每一项都写得清清楚楚，旁边标着唯一的编号
scene: 请举一个具体的例子。Please give a specific example.
sceneCN: 这里 specific 是「具体的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：请举一个具体的例子。

senses.title: Clearly stated
senses.definition: described in enough detail to be clear
senses.definitionCN: 描述得足够详细而清楚
senses.example: Please give a specific example.
senses.why: This is the everyday sense of detail rather than generality.
senses.whyCN: 这是日常表示细节而非笼统的含义。

senses.title: Exact
senses.definition: stated exactly, leaving no doubt
senses.definitionCN: 表述精确，不留疑问
senses.example: The instructions are very specific.
senses.why: Exactness is clarity pushed to a single answer.
senses.whyCN: 确切，是把清楚推到唯一答案。

senses.title: Of one thing only
senses.definition: relating to one particular thing and not others
senses.definitionCN: 只与某一特定事物相关而非其他
senses.example: This drug targets a specific virus.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药针对一种特定的病毒。
senses.why: A detail that belongs to one thing marks it off from the rest.
senses.whyCN: 只属于某一事物的细节，把它与其余区分开来。

intro.en: Specific came from Latin specificus, naming a thing by its kind.
intro.cn: specific 来自拉丁语 specificus，意为按种类来界定某物。

items.en: Species meant kind, and specificus meant of a kind.
items.cn: species 意为种类，specificus 意为属于某一种类的。

items.en: Specificus marked what belongs to one species alone.
items.cn: specificus 标记只属于某一物种的事物。

items.en: Specific entered English as the opposite of general.
items.cn: specific 作为 general 的反义词进入英语。

items.en: It came to mean exact in detail.
items.cn: 它逐渐表示细节上的确切。

items.en: It also named what is special to one thing.
items.cn: 它也指某一事物所特有的。

note.en: Specific is compared with look-alike words and words for exactness.
note.cn: 把 specific 与形近词以及表示确切的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Specific pins a thing down to clear detail or one case.
normalIntro.cn: specific 把事物钉在清楚的细节或某一个例子上。

normal.en: Please give a specific example.
normal.cn: 请举一个具体的例子。

normal.en: The instructions are very specific.
normal.cn: 说明非常明确。

normal.en: This drug targets a specific virus.
normal.cn: 这种药针对一种特定的病毒。

normal.en: We met for a specific purpose.
normal.cn: 我们为特定目的见了面。

normal.en: Each plant has specific needs for light.
normal.cn: 每种植物对光照有特定需求。

abstract.en: The specific is where general truths become real.
abstract.cn: 普遍的道理，在具体之处才成为真实。

abstract.en: A specific name is a handle for an idea.
abstract.cn: 具体的名字是抓住念头的把手。

abstract.en: Vague words float; specific words land.
abstract.cn: 含糊的词漂浮，具体的词落地。

examples.en: Please give a specific example.
The instructions are very specific.
This drug targets a specific virus.
examples.cn: 这种药针对一种特定的病毒。

dict_mnemonic.text: specific 由拉丁语 species（种类）派生，表示「属于某一种的、具体的」；specifically 是「具体地、专门地」，specify 是「具体说明」，specification 是「规格、详细说明」。

root: 来自晚期拉丁语 specificus（属于某一种类的），由 species（种类）加表示「制作、形成」的词根构成，核心义为按种类界定、具体明确。

sensesIntro.en: Specific means clearly detailed, exact, or belonging to one particular thing.
sensesIntro.cn: specific 指细节清楚的、确切的，或属于某一特定事物的。

core.en: Narrowed down to one clear case.
core.cn: 收窄到唯一清楚的情形。

branches.en: One example is named instead of a whole class.
branches.cn: 举出的是一个例子，而不是一整类。

branches.en: A rule leaves no room for doubt.
branches.cn: 一条规则不留任何疑问空间。

branches.en: One medicine seeks one virus only.
branches.cn: 一种药只针对一种病毒。

branches.en: Detail and exactness both narrow the meaning.
branches.cn: 细节与确切都把含义收窄。

branches.en: Being exact is being limited to one thing.
branches.cn: 确切，就是被限定在唯一的事物上。

intro.en: Specific forms adverbs, verbs, and nouns of exact statement.
intro.cn: specific 构成表示确切陈述的副词、动词和名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is specificus, of a kind, built on species.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 specificus（属于某一种类的），由 species 构成。

definition_en: for one particular purpose, in exact detail, or in a clear and direct way
core_image: 书封上印着一行小字，说明这本书只为初学者编写
scene: 这本书是专为初学者写的。This book is written specifically for beginners.
sceneCN: 这里 specifically 是「专门地」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这本书是专为初学者写的。

senses.title: For one purpose
senses.definition: for one particular purpose or group
senses.definitionCN: 为某一特定目的或群体
senses.example: This book is written specifically for beginners.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书是专为初学者写的。
senses.why: This is the common sense of purpose in modern use.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代用法中常见的表示目的的含义。

senses.title: In exact detail
senses.definition: in a way that gives exact details
senses.definitionCN: 以给出确切细节的方式
senses.example: Could you describe the problem more specifically?
senses.exampleCN: 你能更具体地描述一下这个问题吗？
senses.why: It points to detail rather than a general picture.
senses.whyCN: 它指向细节，而不是笼统的图景。

senses.title: Clearly and directly
senses.definition: in a clear and direct way that names something
senses.definitionCN: 以清楚直接、指名道姓的方式
senses.example: The rules specifically forbid smoking here.
senses.exampleCN: 规定明确禁止在此吸烟。
senses.why: Naming a thing outright is the clearest form of statement.
senses.whyCN: 直接点名，是最清楚的陈述方式。
